rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, which matched a single user ID. They retrieved the specific order, confirmed it belonged to the authenticated user, checked product variant availability via tools, and presented accurate options. Before making changes, the agent clearly stated the proposed exchanges and obtained explicit confirmation. They then executed the exchange using the correct item IDs and variants, with the order status updating to exchange requested. The note about a refund to the stored credit card matches the tool-returned negative price difference; no fabricated details were added. While the agent said the request was “processed” rather than explicitly noting “exchange requested,” they provided correct follow-up expectations. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
